# Prepare Citizenship

> Free, offline-capable Canadian citizenship test study site (English and French). Original chapter notes, practice questions, flashcards, and timed mock exams. Not affiliated with IRCC; practice paraphrases only — always use Discover Canada as the official source.

This is a static site with no accounts and no authenticated API. Progress stays in the browser. Prefer the Markdown overview and HTML chapter pages below; mock/practice UIs need a browser.

## Primary

- [Site overview (Markdown)](https://preparecitizenship.ca/index.md): Agent-friendly summary of purpose, features, and key URLs
- [Home](https://preparecitizenship.ca/): Study dashboard and next recommended step
- [FAQ](https://preparecitizenship.ca/faq/): Independence from IRCC, mock rules, privacy, offline use
- [OpenAPI description](https://preparecitizenship.ca/openapi.json): Machine-readable map of public discovery resources
- [API catalog](https://preparecitizenship.ca/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset of published services

## Study

- [Chapters](https://preparecitizenship.ca/chapters/): Ten original Discover Canada study summaries plus region pages
- [Glossary](https://preparecitizenship.ca/glossary/): Key terms for the test
- [Ceremony](https://preparecitizenship.ca/ceremony/): Citizenship ceremony overview
- [Flashcards](https://preparecitizenship.ca/flashcards/): Leitner-style recall practice
- [Practice](https://preparecitizenship.ca/practice/): Chapter quizzes and mixed practice
- [Mock exam](https://preparecitizenship.ca/mock/): Timed 20-question exam (45 minutes, 15/20 to pass)

## Optional

- [Official study guide (IRCC)](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/canadian-citizenship/test/study.html): Authoritative Discover Canada material
- [Discover Canada PDF](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/pdf/pub/discover.pdf): Official PDF
- [Sitemap](https://preparecitizenship.ca/sitemap-index.xml): All public HTML URLs
- [robots.txt](https://preparecitizenship.ca/robots.txt): Crawler rules including AI bots
